title: Crack weight: one hairline everywhere, or a thick-to-thin taper
question: Which one has cracks that start thick at the crater, thin as they run, and give out at different distances?
context_md:
Same charge, same seed, same rock -- only the rule that decides how wide a joint opens has changed.

One of these opens every joint exactly one cell wide and stops opening them at a fixed radius. The other reads each crack's width off how far that crack is going to run, so a crack that starts bold also reaches furthest, and every crack narrows to a hairline and then to nothing at its own distance.

Same number of joints woke in both (785). What differs is their weight and where they stop.

items.label: A -- uniform hairline
items.caption: every seam one cell, opened zone ends on a circle

items.label: B -- tapered aperture
items.caption: width read off each crack's own reach
